newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lernout & Hauspie starts trade on Easdaq.
newsitem.headline: Lernout & Hauspie starts trade on Easdaq.

text.p: Nasdaq-listed Belgian speech technology firm Lernout & Hauspie Speech Products NV on Monday started trading on Easdaq EASDAQ, the market for European growth stocks.
Lernout & Hauspie was quoted unchanged at $25.25.
The Belgian company is the 10th to trade on the exchange which opened in November 1996. Easdaq has said it was aiming for 16 listings by the summer break and 35 by the end of 1997.
Austria's Topcall International AG, a supplier of professional electronic communications systems, said on Sunday that it would make a private offering of shares and start trade on Easdaq on July 11.
Topcall added it would be the first issue on Easdaq with a free float above 50 percent.
Another Austrian firm, Schoeller-Bleckmann Oilfield Equipment AG, was listed on Easdaq earlier this month.
